description: Keep a movie watchlist with personal ratings and a watched toggle.

faqs.a: Add the movie title and year, then rate it 1–5 stars. The star buttons set your personal rating.
faqs.q: How do I add and rate a movie?

faqs.a: Click the Watched toggle on the card. Watched movies move to the Watched section.
faqs.q: How do I mark a movie as watched?

faqs.a: Yes — the average of all your rated movies is shown at the top.
faqs.q: Does it show my average rating?

faqs.a: In this browser's localStorage, private to this device.

howto: Enter the movie title, optional year, and your 1–5 star rating.
Toggle Watched on a card when you've seen it.
Filter by All / To Watch / Watched to browse.
title: Movie Watchlist
